title.zh: 授权菲律宾群岛海关关长向现停泊于马尼拉港并装载大米的船舶“圣尼古拉斯号”颁发临时许可证，准其驶往安博斯卡米内斯省并在该省卸载大米、装载货物后返回马尼拉的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COLLECTOR OF CUSTOMS FOR THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO TO GRANT A TEMPORARY LICENSE TO THE VESSEL SAN NICOLAS, NOW IN THE HARBOR OF MANILA LOADED WITH RICE, TO PROCEED TO THE PROVINCE OF AMBOS CAMARINES AND THERE TO DISCHARGE SAID RICE, TAKE ON A CARGO, AND RETURN TO MANILA.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COLLECTOR OF CUSTOMS FOR THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO TO GRANT A TEMPORARY LICENSE TO THE VESSEL SAN NICOLAS, NOW IN THE HARBOR OF MANILA LOADED WITH RICE, TO PROCEED TO THE PROVINCE OF AMBOS CAMARINES AND THERE TO DISCHARGE SAID RICE, TAKE ON A CARGO, AND RETURN TO MANILA.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Giám đốc Hải quan Quần đảo Philippines cấp giấy phép tạm thời cho tàu San Nicolas, hiện đang neo tại cảng Manila chở gạo, để đi đến Tỉnh Ambos Camarines, dỡ gạo xuống, nhận hàng hóa mới và trở lại Manila
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้ผู้อำนวยการศุลกากรหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ออกใบอนุญาตชั่วคราวให้เรือซานนิโคลัสซึ่งจอดอยู่ในท่าเรือมะนิลาขณะนี้และบรรทุกข้าวไปยังจังหวัดอัมโบสกาเมรีเนสและปล่อยข้าวดังกล่าวลงที่นั่นรับสินค้าขึ้นเรือและกลับมาที่มะนิลา
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengizinkan Direktur Bea Cukai Kepulauan Filipina Memberikan Izin Sementara kepada Kapal San Nicolas yang Saat Ini Berlabuh di Pelabuhan Manila dengan Muatan Beras untuk Berlayar ke Provinsi Ambos Camarines dan Membongkar Beras Tersebut di Sana, Mengambil Muatan, dan Kembali ke Manila
title.ms: Akta Membenarkan Pengarah Kastam Kepulauan Filipina memberikan lesen sementara kepada kapal San Nicolas yang kini berlabuh di pelabuhan Manila dengan muatan beras untuk berlayar ke Wilayah Ambos Camarines dan membongkar beras tersebut di sana, mengambil muatan, dan kembali ke Manila

text.en:
The Collector of Customs for the Philippine Archipelago is hereby authorized to issue a license to
the vessel San Nicolas to proceed to the Province of Ambos Camarines with the cargo of rice she now has,
and to discharge said cargo, take on a cargo from the Province of Ambos Camarines, and to return to the city

Nothing in this Act shall be construed to relieve the vessel San Nicolas or her owners from
liability to fine or other penalty for violation of the coastwise trading laws or regulations prior to the passage

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 1, 1902.
